scope: Actual UI export/save/reopen, closed-authoring-context independent playback, two continuous wraps per action and facing. Repeated-hop candidates are separate from original one-shot jumps. Loop observation is functional evidence, not user visual acceptance.

downloads.note: Candidate packs are retained once in ../exports; identical UI downloads and self-contained project duplicates are validated in temporary storage.
